description: Audits, organizes, migrates, and maintains repository documentation governance: source-of-truth ownership, links and indexes, archive lifecycle, stale references, and documentation drift, while preserving specialized PRD and engineering-plan contracts instead of imposing a fixed layout.

changes: Replace the fixed version-trio default with repository-adaptive documentation authority precedence.
Move PRD and engineering-plan semantics back to specialized artifact-owner workflows.
Make generic validation detect broken links and stale release references while retaining version-trio as an explicit opt-in profile.
